```python
def is_palindrome(s):
    s = s.lower()
    return s == s[::-1]
```

```python
def flatten(list_of_lists):
    return [item for sublist in list_of_lists for item in sublist]
```

```python
def remove_duplicates(lst):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in lst:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result
```

This preserves order and only works with hashable items.
